newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bourses change trading hours as of Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bourses change trading hours as of Monday.

text.p: Brazilian stock exchanges said their trading hours would change beginning Monday due to summertime.
The bourses will open at 1030 local/1330 GMT and close at 1730 local/2030 GMT, with a one-hour break between 1330 and 1430 local.
Trades will be non-stop electronically, they said.
The bourses had been opening at 1000 and closing at 1700 local time, with one-hour break between 1300 and 1400.
The summertime, when clocks will be put forward one hour, will end on February 16, 1997.
